decisions.reason: Indoor air quality monitoring remains in demand and the product has an established market position.
Voltage measurement is a core function for the modular platform and continues to be required by users.
MQTT connectivity remains important, but the software could be superseded by native firmware support in the future.
CO2 monitoring is increasingly important for indoor air quality and the module complements other sensors.
Touch panel remains a useful accessory, though it faces potential replacement by newer interface options.
